aggregationTypes.label: Equivalent RMS
aggregationTypes.explanation: For a future longer-period aggregation, use a duration-weighted root mean square of the five-second RMS values. Do not use a simple arithmetic mean.

aggregationTypes.label: Weighted mean
aggregationTypes.explanation: For a future longer-period aggregation, use the represented-duration-weighted mean of the five-second values.

aggregationTypes.label: Maximum
aggregationTypes.explanation: For a future longer-period aggregation, use the highest five-second maximum in the selected period. Do not average maximum values.
